definitions.explanation: A type of municipality with city-level powers; in practice refers to Tokyo's 23 wards, each with its own mayor and assembly.

examples.japanese: {東京|とうきょう}には{二十三|にじゅうさん}の{特別区|とくべつく}がある。
{特別区|とくべつく}は{市|し}とほぼ{同|おな}じ{権限|けんげん}を{持|も}つ。
examples.english: Special wards have powers almost the same as cities.

examples.japanese: {大阪|おおさか}でも{特別区|とくべつく}を{設置|せっち}するかどうかが{議論|ぎろん}された。
examples.english: Whether to set up special wards was also debated in Osaka.

notes:
Legally a {特別地方公共団体|とくべつちほうこうきょうだんたい} (special local public body). Unlike the ordinary {区|く} of designated cities, a special ward elects its own mayor and assembly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {東京|とうきょう}の{特別区|とくべつく}: the special wards of Tokyo
- {特別区|とくべつく}を{設置|せっち}する: to establish a special ward
- {特別区|とくべつく}{民|みん}: residents of a special ward
